text:
nina (Finance): Cost job flagged a big overnight jump in Dedicated GPU spend for region us-west2. Most of the extra spend shows up as UNASSIGNED in the cost dashboard. https://billing.internal/redwood/costs?range=24h&filter=dedicated

cost-bot: :warning: Spending anomaly detected: dedicated-pool 'dedicated-huge' +22% vs 7d baseline. Alerting #finance #eng-platform

lee (FinOps): Quick look at the billing export: lot of resources from project trial-acme-2026 with missing billing labels (team/cost_center). I can extract instance IDs and compute rough charge. Estimate ~USD 11,400 over last 9 hours.

sam (Platform): That's from the trial onboarding flow that launched ad-hoc Dedicated instances for ACME. We pushed a change last night to enable ephemeral pools and missed setting billing metadata. Working on a patch now.

nina (Finance): Can we retro-assign those costs to ACME? They signed up for a managed trial; Sales said we'd cover initial spin-up but not continuous heavy GPU usage. Need clarity before we invoice.

jordan (Sales): For ACME trial #TR-2026 they agreed we can manage infra. I'll check the terms: sales notes say 72-hour managed trial with usage cap. If they exceeded the cap, we should invoice. Sending a quick note to the customer now, will update thread.

lee (FinOps): Backfill plan: 1) enumerate instance IDs from export 2) apply labels via gcloud 3) re-run billing ingestion backfill (BigQuery). Commands I plan to run (dry-run first):
```
# enumerate
bq query --nouse_legacy_sql '\nSELECT resource.labels.instance_id FROM `billing_export.gcp_resource_usage` WHERE project_id="trial-acme-2026" AND usage_start_time > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 12 HOUR)\n'\n\n# add labels (example)
for id in $(cat instance_ids.txt); do
  gcloud compute instances add-labels $id --labels=team=acme,cost_center=trial-acme --project=trial-acme-2026 --zone=us-west2-a --quiet
done
```

sam (Platform): I'll generate the instance list from deploy logs and run the dry-run label command in staging. I'll wait for Sales/Legal sign-off to apply labels in the customer project.

ivy (Legal): Please confirm customer contract language before changing labels in their project. If Sales has explicit permission in the trial agreement, Legal can confirm. If not, we need a quick written approval from the customer contact.

jordan (Sales): Customer responded: they're okay with us attributing existing trial infra to ACME for billing review as long as we send details and don't charge without approval. They asked for the list of instances and timestamps. I'll paste their email here once I redact PII.

lee (FinOps): Copying the instance snapshot I pulled: trial-acme-01, trial-acme-02, trial-acme-gpu-03, trial-acme-cache-01 (GPU major contributors listed). Full export attached to the ticket. If we get go-ahead, I'll run the add-labels + ingestion backfill. Backfill will adjust cost allocation for the affected window.

nina (Finance): OK. Sales get customer OK in writing and attach to ticket. Once Legal confirms, FinOps can proceed. Finance will hold any invoice until we reconcile. Also please add a short-term monitor to warn on unlabeled Dedicated launches to prevent repeats.

sam (Platform): Added quick alert 'dedicated-unlabeled-launch' -> webhook to #finance and #eng-platform, and opened PR to default labels in onboarding service: https://git.internal/r/onboarding/pull/682

cost-bot: Deploy succeeded: onboarding-service v1.2.4 deployed at 03:22 UTC.

lee (FinOps): I'll be ready to run the backfill once we have documented customer approval. Leaving this thread open until billing is reconciled. :white_check_mark:
